title: Onboarding slate: compact tooltip + panel cards
creator: Anika Shah
description:
Goal: design a compact, reusable 'slate' component that merges a contextual tooltip with an optional side panel and screenshot preview. Slate cards should provide inline help for first-time users and power users discovering new features, surfacing a short explanation (1-2 sentences), an annotated screenshot or GIF, and a single primary action (Try it / Read docs).

Scope: deliver Figma components (3 size variants: micro, compact, expanded), annotated screenshot templates for automated screenshot pipeline, interaction states (hover, focus, pinned), keyboard accessibility flows, and handoff tokens for engineering (spacing, motion, colors). Provide copy variants for onboarding vs. contextual help and provide localization notes for longer languages.

Key constraints: must fit within header and in-panel chrome without overlapping critical UI; must not increase page layout shift above 5 CLS; must work with streaming panel content and in both Hosted and Dedicated product views. Avoid duplicating existing tooltip system: this is a focused onboarding slate with screenshot preview and doc link rather than generic microtips.

Deliverables: Figma components, PNG/JPEG screenshot templates (1280x720 and 800x450), annotated assets for the screenshot pipeline, accessibility checklist, acceptance criteria, and developer handoff package including motion specs and JSON tokens.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file published with 3 responsive component variants (micro, compact, expanded) and documented props: title, body, screenshot, primary action, doc link, pin state.

Annotated screenshot template and naming convention documented and uploaded to Drive: consistent crop and overlay areas for automated screenshot tool (assets: slate_screenshot_1280x720.png, slate_overlay_v1.sketch).

Interaction prototypes for keyboard navigation and screen reader announcements included in the prototype: Tab focus order, Esc to dismiss, Enter to trigger primary action; ARIA label pattern provided.
Design tokens and motion spec documented in a single handoff doc (spacing, durations: 120ms show, 160ms hide, ease-out cubic) and uploaded to the engineering PR referenced below.
Copywriting approved by PM with two length variants and localized guidance for DE/FR/JA (notes included).
Engineering implements slate with <5 CLS and unit tests for pinned state persistence; QA checklist passed on Chrome/Firefox/Safari + mobile responsive breakpoints.
